guarantees.claim: Outputs ready_no, alert_o, ctr_slice_idx_o, ctr_slice_o, ctr_we_no are always directly driven from the out_buf bus via continuous assignment.

uncertain_points.claim: alert_o is driven combinationally from out_buf; if out_buf is not a registered or glitch‑free signal, combinational hazards may cause unintended glitches on alert_o.
uncertain_points.cond: when out_buf changes combinatorially due to FSM logic
uncertain_points.risk: Glitches on alert_o could trigger false safety/security alerts or disrupt fault handling.
